description: Land Title Settlement Department - Durgekanda, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620315 (22/12/00100)
categorisation: This gazette notice calls for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing land ownership, possession, and interest in defined parcels of land in Rathnapura District. It deals with land title settlement, cadastral mapping, and the process for determining land ownership, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
